description: Core invariant contracts for Machine Speed ALMS V2

temporal_order.name: Temporal Order
temporal_order.description: Claimed events must respect chronological order: cause before effect, event time less than or equal to publish time, etc.

numerical_consistency.name: Numerical Consistency
numerical_consistency.description: Stated totals, percentages, and calculations must be mathematically consistent with components.

identity_resolution.name: Identity Resolution
identity_resolution.description: All named entities must resolve to a unique, unambiguous referent.
identity_resolution.formal_rule: every_entity_ref resolves to exactly one grounded identity

cardinality_match.name: Cardinality Match
cardinality_match.description: Claimed counts, quantities, or lists must match the actual number of distinct items.

causal_direction.name: Causal Direction
causal_direction.description: Claimed cause-effect relationships must respect logical and temporal direction.

source_presence.name: Source Presence
source_presence.description: Every material claim must be backed by at least one primary or archival source.

entity_uniqueness.name: Entity Uniqueness
entity_uniqueness.description: The same entity must not be treated as multiple distinct entities within the claim.
entity_uniqueness.formal_rule: no duplicate entity references under different names without justification

logical_consistency.name: Logical Consistency
logical_consistency.description: The claim must not contain internal contradictions or mutually exclusive assertions.
